name: What types of pool equipment do I need for a new pool in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What types of pool equipment do I need for a new pool in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a new pool in Los Angeles, essential equipment typically includes a pump for water circulation, a filter for debris removal, and a heater to extend your swimming season. Beyond these basics, consider a sanitization system like a salt chlorinator or UV/ozone for water purity. Automation systems can integrate these components for easier management. The specific type and size of equipment depend on your pool's volume, desired features, and local regulations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Essential equipment for a new pool in Los Angeles includes a pump, filter, and heater. Sanitization systems and automation are also highly recommended.
